cases.summary: [BUG] The Noon connector was incorrectly storing `class_description` in the `error_message` field instead of the actual error `message`. This affects GSM consistency.
cases.description:
### Bug Description

The Noon connector's error response mapping was storing `class_description` (a classification/category) in the `error_message` field instead of the actual error `message` from Noon's API response.

### Expected Behavior

It should store actual error message in the `error_message` field.

### Actual Behavior

The Noon connector's error response mapping was storing `class_description` (a classification/category) in the `error_message` field instead of the actual error `message` from Noon's API response.

### Steps To Reproduce
